name: expandSingle
label: Expand single
description: When true, allows only one `now-accordion-item` sub-component to expand at a time

name: size
label: Size
description: The amount of horizontal space to show around each item

name: headingLevel
label: Heading level
description: drives the heading level of each accordion items heading according to WAI-ARIA

name: triggerIcon
label: Trigger icon
description: Configures the type ("chevron" or "plus-minus"), position ("start" or "end"), and size ("md" or "sm") of each accordion item trigger icon

name: hideDividers
label: Hide dividers
description: Hides divider lines between accordion items
